_note: The executable half of m8/LEDGER.md section 9. m8src/probe_guard.py reads THIS file, not the prose; m8/LEDGER.md renders it for humans. A probe is runnable only if its row has a non-empty bar, endpoint, comparator, multiplicity and no_survivor, and the bar contains no 'TBD'. Adding or completing a row is a LEDGER section 15 amendment, made BEFORE the run, committed and pushed. The sha256 of this file is stamped into every result artifact before any metric is written.

S0.title: LoTTE overlap screen vs the protected partitions
S0.question: Does any LoTTE slice overlap the reserved or dev CQADupStack components?
S0.endpoint: per (topic, split) slice: community-name intersection; R1-fingerprint document near-duplicate rate; query-leakage hit count
S0.bar: DROP the slice if the community intersection is non-empty, OR the document near-duplicate rate > 0.005, OR any query-leakage hit exists (zero tolerance). REOPEN E10 with Dylan if, after drops, the surviving document near-duplicate rate > 0.02 or fewer than 2 topics survive in the crossing split.
S0.no_survivor: if no slice survives, E10 reopens with Dylan; the session does not substitute another shadow
S0.notes: LoTTE dev and test draw from DISJOINT StackExchange communities within a topic, so the two splits are screened separately. Forum queries only (the search split is non-commercial-research-only per the GooAQ licence).
S0.adopts: nothing; it selects which slices the shadow crossing may use
S0.exempt_reason: a contamination screen, not a quality comparison

T1.title: teacher screen (workstream T)
T1.question: Does any challenger teacher beat the incumbent stella_en_400M_v5 on the closed-form distilled TABLE by more than the swap's CI-widening penalty?
T1.endpoint: closed-form distilled table, equal-weight dev macro of nDCG@10 over cqadup-programmers and cqadup-physics, per-query, int8-irrelevant (closed form)
T1.comparator: the incumbent stella_en_400M_v5, re-probed in the IDENTICAL frame (mandatory control)
T1.bar: ALL FOUR: (1) challenger beats incumbent CI-resolved = raw two-sided 95% paired_dep CI excludes 0 AND signflip_dep p < 0.05; (2) point-estimate margin > the challenger's PRE-CLASSIFIED CI-widening penalty (0.0050 near-sibling / 0.0096 dissimilar, classification fixed below before any result); (3) per-component point-estimate delta >= 0 on BOTH nq-250k AND hotpotqa (one negative component is a reversal and fails); (4) Dylan signs off.
T1.multiplicity: Holm across the challenger set at alpha = 0.05
T1.no_survivor: keep the incumbent -- same-teacher is the registered default
T1.tie_break: two candidates are tied iff the raw 95% CI of their difference lies entirely within +/-0.0040; among tied candidates prefer no disclosed overlap with the protected sets, then the smaller dimension
T1.statistic: boot.paired_dep (B=10000, seed 0) + boot.signflip_dep (R=100000, seed 0), strict alignment
T1.fit_list: regenerated through the current protected-query filter; M7's work/trainq_texts.json has 1.31% R1 hits and is unusable

stella_en_1.5B_v5.note: breaks WordPiece-30522 compatibility; fingerprints rebuilt if it wins

harrier-oss-v1-0.6b.note: training data UNDISCLOSED -- a contamination black box; needs a Dylan ruling BEFORE adoption, not after the screen

T1.penalty_rule: near-sibling iff the challenger shares the incumbent's tokenizer identity (bert-wordpiece-30522) AND its dimension (1024); else dissimilar. Fixed here, before any screen runs.
T1.exempt_reason: closed-form dev probe with its own CI-resolution bar, not a trained-arm comparison; named as exempt in LEDGER 4.7 and 6
T1.blocked_on: B7 -- every challenger's vocabulary is >= 50,368 and the direct fp64 Gram at that size is 20.3 GB, above the 18 GB budget. Until a solver exists that does not materialize the Gram, T1 can only re-run candidates M7 already closed CI-resolved.
T1.frame_note: fixed WITHIN a tokenizer family; a cross-family challenger is screened in its own vocabulary and the comparison is labelled teacher-plus-tokenizer, with the vocabulary size at every row

B2.title: candidate-set entropy (is the KL term degenerate?)
B2.question: H2: is the distillation KL term one-hot to ~1e-4 nats under 31 uniform distractors at temperature 0.02?
B2.endpoint: entropy quantiles of the teacher's candidate distribution, uniform sampling vs top-200 sampling
B2.bar: descriptive; adopts nothing and may not adopt anything
B2.no_survivor: may trigger the separately registered R-LIST arm, or not; it cannot itself change the recipe
B2.exempt_reason: purely descriptive diagnostic, named as exempt in LEDGER 4.7

B3.title: ICT pair fraction (is Phase A pair-starved?)
B3.question: H1: does adding licence-clean ICT pairs to Phase A improve out-of-domain retrieval at equal updates and equal exposure?
B3.endpoint: dense AND fused equal-weight macro of nDCG@10 over the registered out-of-domain group (cqadup-programmers, cqadup-physics), plus the group-vector median over all three dev groups
B3.comparator: ICT fraction 0 (= R0), at equal updates AND equal exposure
B3.bar: B3 TEMPLATE: sign-consistency on BOTH out-of-domain components, AND a seed replicate agreeing in sign, AND the group-vector median gain >= bar(endpoint) from results/m8_noise_floor.json where bar = max(0.0040, 2 x floor)
B3.multiplicity: Holm over the 3 non-zero arms {0.25, 0.50, 0.75} at alpha = 0.05
B3.prior: The clean-stack-tax arm added 490,241 real MS MARCO pairs to the frozen recipe for +0.0058 [-0.0015, +0.0131], unresolved. ICT spans are synthetic and should be worth less per pair. The honest prior is 'a rounding lever'; the caveat that keeps it worth running is that the tax arm held A-steps fixed, so exposure per pair fell as pairs were added.
B3.bar_pending: the numeric floor term; the template and the multiplicity are fixed now

B7.title: block-CG vocabulary curve (gates D2)
B7.question: Can the closed-form table solve be computed at 64K and 128K rows inside this box's budget?
B7.endpoint: solver wall-clock and peak RAM at 30,522 (control) / 65,536 / 131,072 rows, plus the closed-form dev macro at each
B7.bar: FEASIBILITY, binary: the 65,536-row solve must complete within the 18 GB peak-RAM budget and under 4 hours wall-clock. Quality at each size is DESCRIPTIVE at this stage and adopts nothing.
B7.no_survivor: D2 is closed on arithmetic (as granite-r2 and gte-modernbert were in M7: a 50,368-vocab fp64 Gram is 20.3 GB); the milestone routes to D1 / D4' / R1
B7.notes: the fp64 Gram is 34.4 GB at 64K and 137.4 GB at 128K, which is why a block-CG solver is the subject rather than a direct solve
B7.exempt_reason: arithmetic/feasibility gate, named as exempt in LEDGER 4.7

B17.title: in-domain oracle generalization ceiling
B17.question: Does the lookup-table class cap in-domain, or is supervision the binding constraint?
B17.endpoint: nDCG@10 on the held-out query half of the dev CQADupStack components, from an oracle table fitted on the other half
B17.comparator: the 0.481 teacher ceiling on the same half
B17.bar: ROUTING RULE, not an adoption: held-out >= 0.45 => supervision/objective is the story AND R1 takes the majority budget ONLY IF B3-template out-of-domain corroboration is also present; without that corroboration the branch reads 'both'. held-out <= 0.40 => the class caps in-domain and D2/D1/D4' carry the milestone. Between 0.40 and 0.45 => both, budget split 50/50.
B17.no_survivor: the routing rule is exhaustive by construction; there is no 'no survivor' state
B17.notes: its 'short-query loss' framing may NOT be quoted: results/m8_retention_decomposition.json shows the short-query premise does not survive a within-dataset read (LEDGER 17). The in-domain ceiling question is unaffected and is what this probe measures.
B17.exempt_reason: a routing diagnostic against a fixed ceiling, adopting no recipe setting

NF.title: noise-floor measurement (the instrument every bar is set against)
NF.question: How large is a difference this dev instrument produces from nothing at all?
NF.endpoint: group_vector_median, worst_group, out_of_domain_macro and all_component_macro on the full pinned dev suite, int8, through the released QueryTable path
NF.comparator: K=3 arms of the IDENTICAL recipe, identical data, identical B checkpoint, differing ONLY in training seed (a true null)
NF.bar: no bar: this measures the instrument and adopts nothing. It EMITS bars: floor(endpoint) = max of the 3 pairwise |delta|; bar(endpoint) = max(0.0040, 2 x floor(endpoint)).
NF.no_survivor: not applicable -- a floor always exists. If the floor exceeds the planning minimum on an endpoint, every bar reading that endpoint rises accordingly and that is the finding.
NF.also_published: the +/-10% A-steps arms, as RECIPE SENSITIVITY beside the floor, never as the floor: a step change is a treatment, not a null
NF.frame_disclosure: measured in the incumbent teacher frame and the M7 data mix, A leg only with the B checkpoint fixed. An arm differing in its B leg has a larger floor and no bar may read such an arm until that floor is measured too.

dev_aggregation.selection: median of the three group means
dev_aggregation.worst_group: min of the three group means
dev_aggregation.band_provenance: the smallest effect this project has ever adopted (M7 lever #4)

legs.C2: M8 int8 query TABLE > M7 int8 query TABLE on the SAME frozen incumbent document vectors, D1 DISABLED. If the teacher swaps this is unsatisfiable and C2 reverts to the registered alternative: the dense SYSTEM comparison, each on its own teacher's document vectors, D1 still disabled (LEDGER 4.2).

legs_per_hypothesis: Holm-corrected signflip rejection at family alpha
raw one-sided lower bound at alpha/3 > 0, same draws
ship_rule.six_set_margin_provenance: 2.4x the measured near-sibling six-macro paired SE (0.0026-0.0032, from results/perquery.json: leaf-ir-asym vs mdbr-leaf-ir 0.00263, LR-dense-pertask vs LR-dense-websearch 0.00316). P(false veto | truly equal) ~ 0.99; ~80% power against a true regression of ~0.0135.
ship_rule.unknown_key_policy: FAIL -- a key on neither list fails the qualifying condition; classification happens at manifest time, before the access
ship_rule.c2_form_selector: same_teacher -> table-vs-table on identical doc vectors; teacher_swapped -> dense-system-vs-dense-system. Selected by a fact fixed at pipeline step 5, before any M8 number.
ship_rule.six_set_read_timing: scored after the freeze, inside the guarded access process, BEFORE the reserved payloads are opened, written atomically, logged to m8/SIX_ACCESS.log. It is NOT a decision point: the reserved access proceeds regardless of what it says, and nothing about the candidate may change after it. It governs shipping, not measuring.
ship_rule._key_schema_note: EVERY key a candidate manifest can carry is classified here, NOW, while the amendment is legal. The space is train.Cfg's 35 fields plus the artifact-level fields a release records. An unclassified key FAILS condition 4 by design -- but leaving foreseeable keys unclassified would turn the condition into a coin decided by naming conventions at manifest time, which is the opposite of a pre-registration (2026-08-29 review finding).

neutral_keys._why: keys that describe the FRAME rather than a lever. They are neither qualifying nor disqualifying, and they are enumerated so they do not fall through to 'unknown'.

ship_rule.teacher_swap_note: A teacher swap flips teacher_id/encoder_spec (NEUTRAL) and, if it changes tokenizer, also tokenizer_id and vocab -- which ARE qualifying-table keys. That is a side effect of the swap, not an E11-sense v2 lever, so a swap alone must NOT satisfy condition 4: the manifest must declare at least one qualifying_table key that is not tokenizer_id or vocab whenever a teacher swap is in the diff. Registered now, before any swap exists.

shadow_gate.set: LoTTE, forum queries only, surviving slices from S0
shadow_gate.endpoint: equal-weight macro of nDCG@10 over surviving slices, exact search
shadow_gate.comparator: the frozen M7 released system on the identical slices
shadow_gate.go_rule: GO iff BOTH (a) LoTTE surviving-slice macro delta >= -0.0068 (non-regression at the MDE scale) AND (b) dev worst-group >= +0.0068

branches.NO-GO: defer to M9, panel preserved (default) or report-only

noise_floor.floor_statistic: max over the 3 pairwise |delta| on that endpoint
noise_floor.bar_formula: bar(endpoint) = max(planning_minimum, 2 x floor(endpoint)); planning_minimum never below 0.0040
noise_floor.also_published: the +/-10% A-steps perturbation, reported as recipe sensitivity BESIDE the floor, never AS the floor
